chat.title: Umqeqeshi Wemali
chat.greeting: Sawubona Grace! Ngingakusiza kanjani ngemali yakho namuhla?

grow.title: Khulisa imali yami
grow.riskText: Ukukhulisa imali kuhlale kunobungozi. Ungatshali imali ongakwazi ukuyilahlekelwa.

cards.title: Isikhwama sesimo esiphuthumayo
cards.text: Gcina imali encane yezimo ezingalindelekile ukuze ungaboleki.

cards.title: I-akhawunti yokonga
cards.text: Imali ku-akhawunti yokonga iphephe kakhulu kunemali ekhaya futhi ingazuza inzalo.

cards.title: Inzalo eqhubekayo
cards.text: Inzalo ikhula ngenzalo. Ukonga kancane kusenesikhathi kukhula kakhulu.

messages.text: Sawubona Grace! Impuphu yommbila ishibhile ngo-R15 e-Shoprite namuhla.
Kwenziwe. U-R15 ufakwe ku-Frosty. Useku-R1,215 kwezingu-R6,000.
